# dum-tum

> dum-tum is a free, open-source typo and optional AI helper for zsh and Bash on macOS and Linux. It works when the user presses Enter in their normal shell.

Website: https://arjunagi-a-rehman.github.io/dum-tum/
Source and full documentation: https://github.com/arjunagi-a-rehman/dum-tum
npm package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/dum-tum
Install: `npx dum-tum@latest`
License: MIT

## Installation flow

1. `npx` fetches the npm package and its Node entrypoint starts `install.sh` with Bash.
2. The installer selects zsh, Bash, or both. It checks the shell config and required tools: Python 3, curl, and zsh when selected. It can install missing tools with a supported package manager.
3. It stages and validates the runtime files before putting them in `~/.local/share/fixit` by default.
4. It detects supported AI CLIs. The user can choose a CLI, an API provider, or `none` for local typo handling. It can test the selected AI provider.
5. It adds or replaces a managed block in `~/.zshrc` or `~/.bashrc` to load the shell adapter and provider settings.
6. The user opens a new terminal tab or sources the shell config to activate the hook.

## Behavior

- Safe, read-only typo corrections can run locally and automatically. Other corrections require confirmation.
- Plain-English requests can be turned into shell commands with an optional AI provider. AI suggestions always require confirmation before running; the user can run, edit, or cancel.
- Local-only mode handles typos without AI or network requests.
- The `fix` command asks AI to suggest a fix for the last failed command.
- With AI configured, eligible failed commands are sent to the provider automatically by default. Set `FX_AI_ON_FAIL=0` to disable those automatic requests.

## Requirements

- Python 3 and curl.
- zsh 5+ or Bash 4+ on macOS or Linux for the full Enter-key hook.
- The macOS bundled Bash 3.2 supports local typo handling only.

## Safety and privacy

AI mode may send the user request, current directory, directory entries, aliases, and project commands to the chosen provider. Secret detection and redaction are heuristic. Read the complete safety notes before using AI with sensitive work: https://github.com/arjunagi-a-rehman/dum-tum#safety
